Process ordinal2 has both a fast Estimate best12428.5ns and fast p112528.75ns versus its Measure12686.5/12789.25ns. Its paired best/p1 ratios are1.020759/1.020792. Thus the difference is not solely one isolated minimum sample.

The other seven within-process best ratios span0.994685–1.005933. Process7 has both members slower. All eight remain included. Means M/E are about1.002213 best,1.002101 p1 and1.001837 median; these descriptive summaries do not replace the strict merged failure.
Both all-eight absolute member means improve versus the latest matching full-deferred baseline. The current miss does not show a broad Measure regression or deliberately slowed Estimate.

The three other direction/placement cells at N16384 pass; bracketing controls are stable. This supports an instance/context-sensitive anomaly, without proving cache geometry or excluding short disturbances.
The cell was completed during earlier clean monitoring per the retained run attribution; later competing activity invalidates full-run acceptance but does not dismiss this earlier miss.

Record plan/coefficient/I/O/scratch addresses and low page/cache-line residues; verify exact outputs and complete coefficient-owner restoration. Include the original unshifted state in every block. If it follows the execution label/order with the owner exchanged, caller/preparation context is implicated. A common slowdown of both members supports shared I/O/host context.
